## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One important fix remains: the AGENTS.md Commands section still says to run `make test`. After this rename that target no longer exists, and because the repository has no CI, that instruction is the only route to running the test suite.

## Changes
This pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates README.md to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Update the stale `make test` command in AGENTS.md — If an agent follows AGENTS.md and runs `make test` before pushing, make reports that it has no rule for target `test`, because Makefile:6 now defines only `check`. The unchanged line "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." contradicts the new Layout line at AGENTS.md:15, which says the Makefile defines the `check` and `lint` targets. — Agents lose their documented pre-push test step, and AGENTS.md:26 says these commands are the only checks a change gets. — Fix: Change AGENTS.md:24 to "Run `make check` before you push".
